import sys, hashlib
from ethsc.fingerprint import fingerprint, similarity
from ethsc.evm import build_skeleton, extract_selectors, detect_proxy
F = "tests/fixtures/"
def code(n):
    return bytes.fromhex(open(F + n).read().strip()[2:])
bad = []
def chk(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        bad.append("%s: got %r, want %r" % (name, got if len(repr(got)) < 400 else repr(got)[:400] + "...", want))
def fp(c, name):
    try:
        r = fingerprint(c)
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append("%s: fingerprint raised %r" % (name, e)); return None
    if r is not None and not isinstance(r, dict):
        bad.append("%s: fingerprint returned %s, want dict" % (name, type(r).__name__)); return None
    return r
def sim(name, a, b, num, den):
    try:
        s1 = similarity(a, b); s2 = similarity(b, a)
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append("%s: similarity raised %r" % (name, e)); return
    chk(name + " type", (type(s1).__name__, type(s2).__name__), ("float", "float"))
    chk(name + " symmetric", s1 == s2, True)
    chk(name + " value", (abs(s1 - num / den) < 1e-12, round(s1, 4)), (True, round(num / den, 4)))
H2 = "8b5db55fa9ab3b9527508d4abe0b39eb588bf310270c8e04b3f38214e8ba63b4"
A = code("code_univ2_usdc_weth.hex"); B = code("code_univ2_weth_usdt.hex"); W = code("code_weth9.hex"); U = code("code_usdt.hex")
V3a = code("code_univ3_usdc_weth_005.hex"); V3b = code("code_univ3_pool_e0554a47.hex")
BE = code("code_belle.hex"); BC = code("code_belle_copy_1807090d.hex")
C1 = code("code_clone_270df012.hex"); C3 = code("code_clone_2ca7b61b.hex")
fa, fb = fp(A, "Fingerprint Code 1"), fp(B, "Fingerprint Code 1")
if fa and fb:
    chk("Fingerprint Code 1", (fa.get("code_id"), fb.get("code_id"), fa.get("size"), fb.get("size"), len(fa.get("selectors") or []), len(fb.get("selectors") or [])), (H2, H2, 11293, 11293, 27, 27))
fw = fp(W, "Fingerprint Code 2")
if fw:
    chk("Fingerprint Code 2", (fw.get("code_id"), fw.get("size"), fw.get("proxy", "MISSING")), ("5566bf50796faf93c9b6f6adacd3b32c70bfe16b48ffc59db6cd144cbdc89739", 3124, None))
    chk("Fingerprint keys", sorted(fw), ["code_id", "proxy", "selectors", "size", "skeleton_hash"])
    chk("Fingerprint fields", (fw.get("skeleton_hash"), fw.get("selectors")), (hashlib.sha256(build_skeleton(W)).hexdigest(), extract_selectors(W)))
x, y = fp(V3a, "Fingerprint Code 3"), fp(V3b, "Fingerprint Code 3")
if x and y:
    chk("Fingerprint Code 3", (x.get("code_id") != y.get("code_id"), x.get("skeleton_hash") == y.get("skeleton_hash"), x.get("skeleton_hash") == hashlib.sha256(build_skeleton(V3a)).hexdigest()), (True, True, True))
chk("Fingerprint Code 4", fp(b"", "Fingerprint Code 4"), None)
fc = fp(C1, "Fingerprint proxy")
if fc:
    chk("Fingerprint proxy", (fc.get("proxy"), fc.get("selectors"), fc.get("size")), ({"kind": "eip1167", "target": "0x4181f37093e3a21a4e0d5ef355c5b1938cba5bfb"}, [], 45))
sim("Similarity Score 1", W, U, 9, 34)
sim("Similarity Score 2", A, W, 9, 29)
sim("Similarity Score 3", BE, BC, 13, 15)
sim("Similarity Score 4", C1, C3, 1, 1)
sim("Similarity identical", W, W, 1, 1)
sim("Similarity empty", b"", b"", 0, 1)

            bad.append("Tolerant Parser: fingerprint(%r) gave %r, want a dict" % (junk[:8], r))
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append("Tolerant Parser: %r raised on %r" % (e, junk[:8]))
